title: A licensee may not engage in any fraudulent or deceptive act
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(9), a licensee may not engage in any fraudulent or deceptive act.
exam_relevance: Tests recognition of the prohibition on any fraudulent or deceptive act by a licensee as its own paragraph of 247 CMR 9.01, distinct from the advertising provision in 247 CMR 9.03.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: 247 CMR 9.03 is a separate provision addressed to advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
